component.name: ISOForge
component.summary: Inspect, edit and rebuild bootable ISO images

description.p: ISOForge is a native Linux ISO editor. It inspects ISO9660 and UDF images, extracts a temporary workspace, lets you add or remove files, and rebuilds a new image while preserving El Torito BIOS/UEFI boot metadata when the format is supported.
The original image is never modified. Generated images are validated structurally, and the app does not claim that an image boots until an actual VM boot test succeeds.
